title: The payment flow is deceptive.
body: I signed up for a 7-day trial, then an additional bundle charge was hidden behind a Continue button, which seems to be a dark pattern. I immediately canceled and requested a refund, but was told both charges were "non-refundable setup fees". My question about where these non-refundable fees were clearly disclosed before payment was never answered. I lost trust in the service and did not use it at all.

title: Why is my app setting in Chinese?
body:
I’m using my iPhone in Korea, and have my language setting to English and Korean. However, the app keeps displaying instructions in Chinese. I have no idea how the algorithm is set up but just because I’m in Korea, displaying the whole interface in Chinese is unacceptable in my opinion. 

Keep it all in English, and if my phone setting is in Chinese, then display it in Chinese. This needs to be updated. 

The app itself seems like a great idea, but unfortunate I cannot use it at the moment due to language issues. Can’t even change the language setting within the app.
